examples.english: He had the temerity to ask for a raise on his first day at work.
examples.persian: او این گستاخی و جسارت را داشت که در همان روز اول کارش درخواست افزایش حقوق بدهد.

miniContext: He had the temerity to ask for a raise on his first day at work.

examples.english: The tenacious climber refused to turn back even as the storm grew worse.
examples.persian: آن کوهنورد سمج و پیگیر حتی با تشدید طوفان هم حاضر به بازگشت نشد.

miniContext: The tenacious climber refused to turn back even as the storm grew worse.

examples.english: The coach launched into a tirade after the team missed three easy goals.
examples.persian: مربی پس از از دست دادن سه گل آسان توسط تیم، سخنرانی تند و حمله‌آمیزی را آغاز کرد.

miniContext: The coach launched into a tirade after the team missed three easy goals.

examples.english: The snake lay torpid in the sun, barely moving for hours.
examples.persian: مار بی‌حال و کند زیر نور خورشید دراز کشیده بود و ساعت‌ها به‌سختی حرکت می‌کرد.

miniContext: The snake lay torpid in the sun, barely moving for hours.

examples.english: The joy of winning the lottery was transient; within a year, he felt just as restless as before.
examples.persian: شادی برنده شدن در قرعه‌کشی موقتی و زودگذر بود؛ ظرف یک سال، او دوباره به همان اندازه بی‌قرار شد.

miniContext: The joy of winning the lottery was transient; within a year, he felt just as restless as before.

examples.english: She walked into the exam room with trepidation, unsure if she had studied enough.
examples.persian: او با ترس و اضطراب وارد اتاق امتحان شد، بدون اینکه مطمئن باشد کافی درس خوانده است.

miniContext: She walked into the exam room with trepidation, unsure if she had studied enough.

examples.english: The truculent customer threatened to sue over a two-dollar discount.
examples.persian: آن مشتری خشن و ستیزه‌جو تهدید کرد به‌خاطر یک تخفیف دو دلاری شکایت می‌کند.

miniContext: The truculent customer threatened to sue over a two-dollar discount.

examples.english: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, appearing in the hands of people of every age.
examples.persian: گوشی‌های هوشمند همه‌جا حاضر شده‌اند و در دست افرادی از هر سنی دیده می‌شوند.

miniContext: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, appearing in the hands of people of every age.

examples.english: Despite winning the Nobel Prize, the scientist remained unassuming and still rode his old bicycle to work.
examples.persian: با وجود بردن جایزه نوبل، آن دانشمند بی‌ادعا و متواضع باقی ماند و همچنان با دوچرخه قدیمی‌اش به محل کار می‌رفت.

miniContext: Despite winning the Nobel Prize, the scientist remained unassuming and still rode his old bicycle to work.

examples.english: The depth of the ocean trench remains largely unfathomable to scientists even today.
examples.persian: عمق آن گودال اقیانوسی حتی امروز نیز تا حد زیادی برای دانشمندان درک‌ناپذیر باقی مانده است.

miniContext: The depth of the ocean trench remains largely unfathomable to scientists even today.

examples.english: Her answer to the job offer was an unequivocal yes.
examples.persian: پاسخ او به پیشنهاد شغلی، یک بله کاملاً صریح و بدون ابهام بود.

miniContext: Her answer to the job offer was an unequivocal yes.

examples.english: The storm caused unprecedented flooding that the city had never seen before.
examples.persian: آن طوفان سیلابی بی‌سابقه ایجاد کرد که شهر هرگز پیش از آن تجربه نکرده بود.

miniContext: The storm caused unprecedented flooding that the city had never seen before.

meaning: چاپلوسانه و بیش از حد صمیمی

examples.english: The unctuous salesman kept complimenting her shoes, her bag, and her perfume to win her trust.
examples.persian: آن فروشنده چاپلوس و بیش از حد صمیمی، پیوسته از کفش، کیف و عطر او تعریف می‌کرد تا اعتمادش را جلب کند.

miniContext: The unctuous salesman kept complimenting her shoes, her bag, and her perfume to win her trust.

examples.english: Without any evidence, his argument quickly became untenable in front of the committee.
examples.persian: بدون هیچ مدرکی، استدلال او به‌سرعت در برابر کمیته غیرقابل دفاع شد.

miniContext: Without any evidence, his argument quickly became untenable in front of the committee.

examples.english: The general planned to usurp the throne while the king was away at war.
examples.persian: آن ژنرال قصد داشت در غیاب پادشاه که به جنگ رفته بود، تاج‌وتخت را غصب کند.

miniContext: The general planned to usurp the throne while the king was away at war.

meaning: مردد بودن و مدام تغییر نظر دادن

examples.english: He kept vacillating between the red car and the blue one for nearly an hour.
examples.persian: او تقریباً یک ساعت میان خودروی قرمز و آبی مردد بود و مدام نظرش را عوض می‌کرد.

miniContext: He kept vacillating between the red car and the blue one for nearly an hour.

examples.english: The villagers venerate the old oak tree, believing it brings good fortune.
examples.persian: روستاییان درخت بلوط قدیمی را با احترام بسیار می‌ستایند و باور دارند که خوش‌شانسی می‌آورد.

miniContext: The villagers venerate the old oak tree, believing it brings good fortune.

examples.english: The instructions were so verbose that most customers gave up reading them halfway through.
examples.persian: دستورالعمل‌ها چنان پرحرف و طولانی بودند که بیشتر مشتریان نیمه‌راه از خواندنشان دست کشیدند.

miniContext: The instructions were so verbose that most customers gave up reading them halfway through.

meaning: غیرمستقیم و از طریق دیگری تجربه‌شده

examples.english: Watching her daughter perform on stage gave the mother a vicarious thrill she had never felt herself.
examples.persian: تماشای اجرای دخترش روی صحنه، لذتی غیرمستقیم به مادر داد که خودش هرگز تجربه نکرده بود.

miniContext: Watching her daughter perform on stage gave the mother a vicarious thrill she had never felt herself.

examples.english: New DNA evidence finally vindicated the man after twenty years in prison.
examples.persian: شواهد جدید دی‌ان‌ای سرانجام، پس از بیست سال حبس، آن مرد را تبرئه کرد.

miniContext: New DNA evidence finally vindicated the man after twenty years in prison.

examples.english: The virulent strain of the virus spread through the hospital within days.
examples.persian: آن گونه بسیار شدید و خصمانه ویروس در عرض چند روز در سراسر بیمارستان پراکنده شد.

miniContext: The virulent strain of the virus spread through the hospital within days.

examples.english: The critic's vitriolic review left the young director in tears.
examples.persian: نقد تلخ و گزنده آن منتقد، کارگردان جوان را به گریه انداخت.

miniContext: The critic's vitriolic review left the young director in tears.

examples.english: The vociferous crowd outside the stadium could be heard from three blocks away.
examples.persian: جمعیت پرسروصدا و شدید بیرون ورزشگاه، از سه بلوک دورتر هم شنیده می‌شد.

miniContext: The vociferous crowd outside the stadium could be heard from three blocks away.

examples.english: The soldiers were punished for the wanton destruction of the village's only well.
examples.persian: سربازان به‌خاطر تخریب بی‌مهار و بی‌دلیل تنها چاه روستا تنبیه شدند.

miniContext: The soldiers were punished for the wanton destruction of the village's only well.

examples.english: The deer stayed wary, lifting its head at every snap of a twig.
examples.persian: آهو محتاط و هوشیار ماند و با هر صدای شکستن شاخه‌ای سرش را بالا می‌آورد.

miniContext: The deer stayed wary, lifting its head at every snap of a twig.

examples.english: The children's book was full of whimsical creatures, like a cat that wore tiny rain boots.
examples.persian: کتاب کودکان پر از موجودات دمدمی و خیال‌پرداز بود، مانند گربه‌ای که چکمه‌های کوچک بارانی می‌پوشید.

miniContext: The children's book was full of whimsical creatures, like a cat that wore tiny rain boots.

examples.english: She gave a wistful smile looking at old photographs of her college years.
examples.persian: او با نگاه کردن به عکس‌های قدیمی دوران دانشگاهش، لبخندی حسرت‌آلود زد.

miniContext: She gave a wistful smile looking at old photographs of her college years.

examples.english: The zealous volunteer arrived an hour early to set up chairs for the fundraiser.
examples.persian: آن داوطلب پرانرژی و مشتاق، یک ساعت زودتر رسید تا صندلی‌ها را برای جمع‌آوری کمک‌های مالی آماده کند.

miniContext: The zealous volunteer arrived an hour early to set up chairs for the fundraiser.

examples.english: Religious zealotry drove the group to reject even harmless modern inventions.
examples.persian: تعصب شدید مذهبی آن گروه را به رد کردن حتی اختراعات مدرن بی‌ضرر سوق داد.

miniContext: Religious zealotry drove the group to reject even harmless modern inventions.

examples.english: The company reached the zenith of its success just before the market crashed.
examples.persian: شرکت درست پیش از سقوط بازار، به اوج موفقیت خود رسید.

miniContext: The company reached the zenith of its success just before the market crashed.
